12a

Since the particle’s velocity does not change, the net force on the particle is zero as it is moving through the field. 

This means that the gravitational force and the electromagnetic force that act on the particle are equal in magnitude and point in opposite directions, therefore the direction of the electromagnetic force on the particle is upwards.

Based on the above and using Fleming’s left-hand rule we get that the direction of the ‘conventional’ current (so the direction in which positive charge would move) is to the left. 

Therefore the charge on the particle is negative.
